notes.title: Announcement for the Stunning Update of the New Version of Legend of Nezha
notes.notes:
[p]Dear Nezha Warriors,[/p][p]
[/p][p]To recreate the passionate legendary experience and create a carnival for all players, [i]Legend of Nezha[/i] will launch a full-server update. This update introduces the "Carnival of Gods and Demons" version, featuring core content such as a revolution in 新手福利 (new player benefits), daily zero-charge privileges, and a loot rate surge system. It also optimizes the fairness of trading and competition, helping every warrior enjoy the mythical world to the fullest![/p][h3][b]I. New Welfare System: Become a God Without Spending, Resources Galore[/b][/h3][p]New Player Benefits 2.0: Peak at the Start[/p][p]
[/p][p]Log in to receive:[/p][p]
[/p][list][*][p]Rare title "Descendant of the Spirit Orb" (Attack +5%)[/p][/*][*][p]Permanent auto-pickup/recycling functions[/p][/*][*][p]100-slot large backpack + 50-slot warehouse
Say goodbye to tedious operations![/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][p]Zero-Charge Gift Pack:
Log in on the first day to get 1000 Spirit Talismans (in-game currency), which can be directly exchanged for top-tier beginner equipment "Red Satin of Chaos · Elementary".[/p][p]
[/p][p]Daily Zero-Charge Privileges: Daily Recharge Quota[/p][p]
[/p][p]Online Rewards: Stay online for 1 hour daily to receive a free 50-yuan recharge quota (can be accumulated and used with no thresholds to redeem mall items).[/p][p]
[/p][p]Activity Chests: Complete daily tasks to unlock; there’s a chance to get 10,000-yuan recharge card fragments (10 fragments 合成 (synthesize) 1 card, max 3 cards daily).[/p][p]
[/p][p]Loot Rate Surge: Equipment & Titles Drop from Monsters[/p][p]
[/p][p]First Kill Reward: The player who makes the server-first kill of BOSS "East Sea Dragon King" will exclusively get 10 million Spirit Talismans + exclusive title "Dragon-Slaying Warrior" (All Attributes +10%).[/p][p]
[/p][p]1000x Drop Rate: All 野外 (wild) BOSSes and elite monsters drop super-transformed exclusive equipment (e.g., "Universal Ring・Divine Grade") and cool fashion fragments (collect to redeem permanent appearances).[/p][p]
[/p][p]Title Carnival: Kill a specified number of monsters to unlock premium titles (e.g., "Demon-Slaying Vanguard", "Demon Lord Bane"), with unlimited attribute stacking![/p][h3][b]II. Core Feature Upgrades: Playable & Fair, Crafted with Care[/b][/h3][p]No Gimmicks, Truly Playable[/p][p]
[/p][p]Zero Payment Threshold: No first-recharge gift packs, no forced consumption; all content can be obtained through monster-slaying/quests.[/p][p]
[/p][p]Continuous Updates: 3 new featured gameplay modes (e.g., "Fengshen List Cross-Server Battle", "Nezha Disturbs the Sea Dungeon") are added monthly, ensuring long-term engagement without boredom![/p][p]
[/p][p]Crafted with Passion, Passionate Experience[/p][p]
[/p][p]Team Dedication: 1 year spent optimizing combat feel and visual effects, with 50% improved skill release fluency; combat feedback rivals PC games![/p][p]
[/p][p]Popularity Guarantee: Large servers with 1000 players on the same screen are available, with "Gods vs. Demons Battle" starting promptly at 20:00 daily—passion never ends![/p][p]
[/p][p]Three Easier Hunts, Full of Benefits[/p][p]
[/p][p]Currency Easy to Hunt: All monsters drop in-game currency; daily AFK 收益 (rewards) exceed 5 million, making skill upgrades effortless![/p][p]
[/p][p]Equipment Easy to Hunt: BOSSes guaranteed to drop purple gear, with a chance for orange gear; casual players can collect a full endgame set in 3 days![/p][p]
[/p][p]Recharge Easy to Hunt: Participate in events like "Heavenly Trial" and "Peach Banquet" to get free recharge cards (up to 500-yuan quota daily)![/p][h3][b]III. Game Highlights: Fair Competition, Free Trading[/b][/h3][p]Fair Growth, Casual Players’ Paradise[/p][p]
[/p][p]Time to Graduate: No VIP level suppression; as long as online time is sufficient, all players can achieve ultimate graduation![/p][p]
[/p][p]Free Trading: The stall system is fully open; equipment, materials, and Spirit Talismans can be freely priced, letting you earn your first pot of gold![/p][p]
[/p][p]Super Fun PK, No Instant Kill[/p][p]
[/p][p]Smooth Competition: Network latency optimized, zero lag in skill release; 1000-player team battles run stably at 60 FPS![/p][p]
[/p][p]Balanced Settings: Removed "One Hit 999" and other over-powered attributes; PK outcomes depend on operation and strategy—anyone can dominate the server![/p][h3][b]IV. Popularity Soars, Metrics Maxed[/b][/h3][p]New Player Metric: ★★★★★★★★★★★★★ (User-friendly tutorial, master in 5 minutes)[/p][p]
[/p][p]Fun Metric: ★★★★★★★★★★★★★ (Loot rate, welfare, and combat experience fully upgraded)[/p][p]
[/p][p]Popularity Metric: ★★★★★★★★★★★★★ (Expected 100,000+ players on launch day)[/p][h3][b]V. Maintenance Compensation & Notes[/b][/h3][p]Compensation Content: All servers will receive 2000 Spirit Talismans + auto-recycling function (7 days) + title "Maintenance Pioneer" (compensation claim deadline: 23:59 on July 27).[/p][p]
[/p][p]Data Retention: Character, equipment, and currency data will be fully retained after the update—feel free to enjoy the new version![/p][p]
[/p][p]Feedback: If you encounter bugs or have suggestions, submit them via the in-game "Customer Service" button; we will handle them promptly and reward you with 500 Spirit Talismans![/p][p]
[/p][p]Sincerely,
[i]Legend of Nezha[/i] Operation Team
July 21, 2025[/p]
